description: This file contains Java test class `MongoTimestampPersistenceIT` which performs integration testing on the `MongoTimestampPersistence` class. It includes setup and teardown methods for MongoDB resources, and test cases for timestamp persistence behavior, collection handling, and concurrency scenarios.

classes.name: MongoTimestampPersistenceIT
classes.description: Integration test class for `MongoTimestampPersistence`, testing timestamp retrieval, updating, collection behavior, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes and starts the embedded MongoDB resource before all tests.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource and closes client after all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up actor system, materializer, and initializes the persistence instance before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as dropping collections and shutting down actor system after each test.

methods.name: retrieveFallbackForLastSuccessfulSyncTimestamp
methods.description: Tests that retrieving timestamp when none is set returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: updateAndRetrieveLastSuccessfulSyncTimestamp
methods.description: Tests setting a timestamp and then retrieving it matches the stored value.

methods.name: ensureCollectionIsCapped
methods.description: Tests that the Mongo collection enforces a cap and only retains the last inserted document.

methods.name: createCollectionMultipleTimesWithoutError
methods.description: Verifies that multiple initializations of the persistence do not cause errors.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Helper to obtain a single result from a reactive stream source, blocking until completion.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Runs a publisher to completion and collects the results into a list or single result.

methods.name: mapAsRuntimeException
methods.description: Maps an exception to a RuntimeException for consistent error handling.
